2. What the work reached

The burst rate was 238.4 units/s, unchanged from the 237.6 units/s the earlier pass reported, so the machine is stable across editions.

The roof it was measured against is 290.0 units/s, which is what the units reached with the work resident.

The configured limit held for every one of the 201 busy samples, which is why the limit and not the roof is the thing to talk about. The thermal side of this is in see section 18.

3. What was submitted

Inputs are unique by construction, so nothing measured here was served from a cache.

The mixture is weighted towards the smallest size, whose assumed share is 0.35.

Across that mixture the rate works out at 83.44 units/s, and the short-size share of 0.35 is what drives it.
